description: This PHP source file defines a model class 'BulkLeaveEntitlementMatchingEmployeeModel' used in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. The class represents a data structure handling employee leave entitlements, including methods for serialization and constructor logic. It includes annotations for API schema documentation and references to external entity classes.

classes.name: BulkLeaveEntitlementMatchingEmployeeModel
classes.description: A model class representing an employee's leave entitlement data, including employee details and entitlement calculations, with capability to serialize to array format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with arrays of Employee and LeaveEntitlement objects and an optional entitlement float.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the object data into an array suitable for API responses, combining employee details with entitlement information.

methods.name: getEntitlementArrayWithEmpNumberAsKey
methods.description: Creates an associative array mapping employee numbers to their entitlement objects, checking for consistency.
